Add RIAINTRA to your Home Screen

On iPhone or iPad, open the Share menu in Safari and choose Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and choose Add to Home screen or Install, if offered.

This adds a shortcut to RIAINTRA; an internet connection and a valid staff session are still required.
